name: ApeX Studio
description: ApeX Studio is a premium digital agency building high-performance websites, AI-powered product visuals, 3D web experiences, chatbots, and full-stack automations for modern brands.
longDescription: ApeX Studio is a next-generation digital agency for businesses that refuse to blend in. We combine world-class web development with cutting-edge AI tools to create digital experiences that perform, convert, and command attention. From pixel-perfect websites to intelligent chatbots and end-to-end AI automation, we give your brand the tech advantage it needs to outperform the competition.

faqs.question: What does ApeX Studio do?
faqs.answer: ApeX Studio is a premium digital agency specializing in high-performance websites, AI product posters, 3D web experiences, AI automations, chatbots, and brand identity systems. We help modern brands build stronger, more conversion-focused digital presences.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: Most projects take between 3 and 8 weeks depending on scope. A focused landing page can ship in 2 weeks, while a full brand identity plus custom web platform typically takes 6 to 8 weeks. We share a clear timeline during the discovery phase.

faqs.question: What technologies do you use?
faqs.answer: We build with modern, production-grade tooling: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Firebase, WebGL/Three.js for 3D, and the OpenAI / Anthropic APIs for AI features. We choose the right tool for each project rather than forcing a stack.

faqs.question: Do you work with early-stage startups?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work with funded startups, scale-ups, and established brands. For early-stage teams, we often start with a focused landing page or MVP that can grow into a full platform as traction builds.

faqs.question: Where are you based? Do you work remotely?
faqs.answer: ApeX Studio is based in Hyderabad, India, and we work with clients worldwide. Our process is fully remote-friendly with async updates, weekly demos, and a shared project workspace.

faqs.question: How much does a project cost?
faqs.answer: Project investment depends on scope, but most engagements start from a focused landing page and scale up to full brand + platform builds. Reach out through the contact form for a tailored proposal within 48 hours.
